answer_text:
**Lucas Adams** currently plays Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless*. Lucas Adams joined *The Young and the Restless* in November 2025 as Noah Newman, the prodigal son of Sharon (Sharon Case) and Nick Newman (Joshua Morrow).

Adams is best known for playing the role of Dr. Tripp Dalton Johnson on the NBC and Peacock soap opera *Days of Our Lives* (2017 to 2024). He earned two Daytime Emmy nominations for Outstanding Younger Actor along the way.

The role of Noah Newman has been played by several actors over the years:
- Kevin Schmidt was the first actor to play Noah after the character was aged, appearing from 2008 to September 2010, when the role was recast with Luke Kleintank before being let go in April 2011, with Schmidt being rehired.
- Schmidt was again let go in 2012 and replaced by Robert Adamson, who held the role until his departure in 2018.
- Rory Gibson debuted in the role in 2021 and made his last appearance in April 2023, when Noah left Genoa City and moved to London.
- The character returned in 2025, with Lucas Adams assuming the role, with Adams first appearing on November 4.
